Round 34: US3_PS3 meets H1/H2 (-7.59 dB, eta >= 0.654) but is not better than P01_MS2; two-mesh pair 035/036 under way.

Round 36: US3_PS4 reaches -10.66 dB over the channel (two minima 7.826/8.158 GHz) but the efficiency valley follows the upper mode (0.24, -0.5 dBi). design-reviewer (Fable) asked for design advice (owner instruction).

Round 37: US3_PS5 (design-reviewer proposal) removes the efficiency valley (eta 0.64-0.69) but S11 shifts ~70 MHz up (worst -6.87 dB). HFSS scripts of US3_PS4 verified by design-reviewer (minor corrections applied). Round 38: US3_PS6 recentred.

Rounds 49-50 (owner: widen US3_PS6). 049 US3_PS6_3 (Lp 7.25) covers the channel at -10 dB but eta drops to 0.34. 050 US3_PS6_4 (wide patch W 14 mm) covers the channel at -10 dB with a single minimum at 7.936 GHz and flat eta 0.65-0.71 (base mesh only). Validator OK with observations.
Round 51 (owner authorised): fine mesh of US3_PS6_4 confirms channel coverage at -10 dB (worst -11.24 dB, max |dGamma| 0.015 vs base). Validator OK with observations. US3_PS6_4 declared candidate.

Owner sends US3_PS6_4 to HFSS. em-solver builds element and ARR1x5 scripts; design-reviewer: element ready, array needs MaximumPasses 25 (applied), arr_d grid 16.5-20.5, wave-port control copy procedure rewritten. rf-designer pre-registers HFSS hypotheses. code-auditor LISTO.

HFSS element of US3_PS6_4 (owner): H_HFSS0 and H_HFSS2 met, worst S11 -9.82 dB (misses -10 dB by 0.18 dB, within the convergence uncertainty). Validator OK with observations; wave-port check pending before HFSS_VALIDATED for S11. HFSS 1x5 array of US3_PS6 exported (16 pitches).
HFSS 1x5 array of US3_PS6_4 (owner): converged at all 11 pitches; validator OK with observations. Owner re-simulating P01_MS2 (element and arrays) and the US3_PS4_2_1 array for consistent exports.
HFSS P01_MS2 element and 1x4 array (owner re-simulation): validator OK with observations. 1x4 vs 1x5 virtual HPBW ratio 0.72-0.76 justifies the fifth element.

HFSS 1x5 array of P01_MS2 re-exported with convergence.conv (same stored solution as 2026-11-15): validator OK with observations. 1x4 vs 1x5 at 18.2 mm: virtual HPBW 22.5 -> 16.4 deg (a), 15.2 -> 11.9 deg (b). Evidence text of the array analysis scripts now reads convergence.conv.

HFSS 1x5 array of US3_PS4_2_1 converged at dS 0.01 (15 pitches, 20 mm not solved): validator OK with observations. Worst Sii improves 0.2-0.7 dB, beams unchanged; 18.2 mm less refined than neighbours.
